say:1:1010401001:0.text:
You look tired, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I know you've been working hard.
Tell me, have you made any new discoveries?
say:1:1010401001:0.male:
You look tired, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I know you've been working hard.

say:1:1010401001:0.female:

say:3:1010401002:0.text: So Lord Franz was behind the fire...
say:3:1010401002:0.source_cn: 原来弗朗茨才是纵火的幕后主使……
say:3:1010401002:0.male: So Lord Franz was behind the fire...
say:3:1010401002:0.female: So Lord Franz was behind the fire...

say:4:1010401003:0.text: From behind the scenes, he's been using his wealth to make his puppets do his bidding.
say:4:1010401003:0.source_cn: 他躲在暗处，凭借丰厚的财力操控着一群木偶。
say:4:1010401003:0.male: From behind the scenes, he's been using his wealth to make his puppets do his bidding.
say:4:1010401003:0.female: From behind the scenes, he's been using his wealth to make his puppets do his bidding.

say:6:1010401013:0.text: That's exactly what I was afraid of.

say:7:1010401014:0.text: Unfortunately, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there's not enough evidence to charge Lord Franz.
say:7:1010401014:0.male: Unfortunately, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there's not enough evidence to charge Lord Franz.
say:7:1010401014:0.female: Unfortunately, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there's not enough evidence to charge Lord Franz.

say:8:1010401015:0.text: Even if we bring witnesses to testify against him, all he has to do is feign ignorance and render our accusations meaningless.
say:8:1010401015:0.source_cn: 就算我们压着证人去找他对质，只要他矢口否认，说自己毫不...

say:9:1010401016:0.text: We need more conclusive proof, something that even he won't be able to deny.
say:9:1010401016:0.source_cn: 必须抓住更直观的证据，让他无话可说。

say:10:1010401017:0.text: Before that, let me bring Miss Mirael here first. Now that we know she's not the culprit, she shouldn't be locked up.
say:10:1010401017:0.source_cn: 在此之前，我先带米瑞尔女士过来。\n她洗清了嫌疑 ，理...

say:11:1010401018:0.text: She got blamed for this. She deserves to know the truth.
say:11:1010401018:0.source_cn: 她为此蒙冤，也有权了解真相。

narration:14:1010401019:0.text: After a while, a guard appears with Mirael.
narration:14:1010401019:0.source_cn: 等待一段时间后，卫兵带米瑞尔过来了

say:21:1010401022:0.text: Umm... I know you don't want to see me right now, Miss Mirael.
say:21:1010401022:0.source_cn: 那个……米瑞尔小姐，我知道，你肯定不想见到我。

say:22:1010401023:0.text: But I would like to apologize for unjustly accusing you earlier. You see, all of this is...
say:22:1010401023:0.source_cn: 很抱歉之前冤枉了你，关于这一切，我想向你——

say:24:1010401025:0.text: If anything, I should thank you.
say:24:1010401025:0.source_cn: 说不定，反而是我该谢谢你的纠缠呢。

say:25:1010401026:0.text: If it wasn't for you, he wouldn't be running around for my sake.
say:25:1010401026:0.male: If it wasn't for you, he wouldn't be running around for my sake.
say:25:1010401026:0.female: If it wasn't for you, she wouldn't be running around for my sake.

say:30:1010401030:0.text: I know you have questions, but let's meet elsewhere to talk. The gardens to the northwest, maybe. My favorite flowers grow there.
say:30:1010401030:0.source_cn: 你一定有问题想问我，我们换个地方聊，就选在西北边的小花...
say:30:1010401030:0.male: I know you have questions, but let's meet elsewhere to talk. The gardens to the northwest, maybe. My favorite flowers grow there.
say:30:1010401030:0.female: I know you have questions, but let's meet elsewhere to talk. The gardens to the northwest, maybe. My favorite flowers grow there.

say:32:1010401032:0.text: Just the two of us. Think of it like a...
say:32:1010401032:0.source_cn: 这是，独属于我们二人的……
say:32:1010401032:0.male: Just the two of us. Think of it like a...
say:32:1010401032:0.female: Just the two of us. Think of it like a...

say:36:1010401034:0.source_cn: 约、约会？她刚刚说了……约会？

say:40:1010401036:0.text: What?! Don't ask something silly like that, Chippy!
say:40:1010401036:0.source_cn: 呀——！！！不要问这么愚蠢的问题啊！

say:44:1010401037:0.text:
Ahem... We should return to the Heroic Order, Valen.
You had something important to report, didn't you?
say:44:1010401037:0.source_cn: 咳……维、维伦，我们走吧，回骑士团。\n你刚刚不是有要...

say:47:1010401038:0.text: Hm? Not really... Hey! General! Why are you dragging me away?!
say:47:1010401038:0.source_cn: 啊？不是……喂！将军——你别拽我啊！

say:51:1010401039:0.text: Wow... It seems like something interesting is happening.
say:51:1010401039:0.source_cn: 哇哦……感觉要发生有意思的事情了。
say:51:1010401039:0.male: Wow... It seems like something interesting is happening.
say:51:1010401039:0.female: Wow... It seems like something interesting is happening.

say:52:1010401040:0.text: Don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'll keep my ears nice and shut! I swear to Misarte that I won't eavesdrop!
say:52:1010401040:0.male: Don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'll keep my ears nice and shut! I swear to Misarte that I won't eavesdrop!
say:52:1010401040:0.female: Don't worry, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'll keep my ears nice and shut! I swear to Misarte that I won't eavesdrop!

say:54:1010401029:0.text: I know you never like to say how you actually feel.
say:54:1010401029:0.source_cn: 我知道，你嘴上说的和心里想的，总是不太一样。
say:54:1010401029:0.male: I know you never like to say how you actually feel.
say:54:1010401029:0.female: I know you never like to say how you actually feel.

say:55:1010401005:0.text: Forgive me, but I trust you more than anyone else. That's why I trouble you with such matters so often.
say:55:1010401005:0.source_cn: 真抱歉啊……因为你是我最信任的人，所以总是麻烦你。
say:55:1010401005:0.male: Forgive me, but I trust you more than anyone else. That's why I trouble you with such matters so often.
say:55:1010401005:0.female: Forgive me, but I trust you more than anyone else. That's why I trouble you with such matters so often.

say:56:1010401006:0.text: When this is all over, I'd like to treat you to a meal at the <style="highlight">Traveler's Light</style>. What do you say?
say:56:1010401006:0.source_cn: 等这些事情忙完，我请你去<style=highligh...
say:56:1010401006:0.male: When this is all over, I'd like to treat you to a meal at the <style="highlight">Traveler's Light</style>. What do you say?
say:56:1010401006:0.female: When this is all over, I'd like to treat you to a meal at the <style="highlight">Traveler's Light</style>. What do you say?

say:58:1010401007:0.text:
That's the most famous restaurant in town!
I've never seen you spend that kind of money, General! You gotta invite me too!
say:58:1010401007:0.source_cn: 那可是镇上最有名的餐厅！\n将军，难得见您破费，请客的...

say:59:1010401008:0.text: I've been protecting <style="stress"><player_name></style> just like you ordered. No good deed should go unrewarded, right?
say:59:1010401008:0.source_cn: 我可是奉您的命令一直保护着<style=stress>...
say:59:1010401008:0.male: I've been protecting <style="stress"><player_name></style> just like you ordered. No good deed should go unrewarded, right?
say:59:1010401008:0.female: I've been protecting <style="stress"><player_name></style> just like you ordered. No good deed should go unrewarded, right?

say:60:1010401009:0.text: Yes, yes, just give it a rest already.

say:62:1010401010:0.text: Now then, back to official business.
